Name: Mayor Krobus
Author: himanbam
Description:
Krobus is the mayor now.

Basically a reskin of Lewis to make him look like Krobus.


Can be used with my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43977]Sewer Lewis[/url].


*Note this does not change his name, birthday, or any dialogue.
However if you want those changes, you can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9271]Ultimate Villager Manager[/url] mod by ApollyonSV. Then, change the config as described below.

[line][b]
[size=4]Ultimate Villager Manager Config Instructions:
[/size][/b]
Go to the Lewis section.
Change Lewis' name to Krobus.
You can also change his birthday to Krobus' birthday (Winter 1).
That mod will update dialogue and events to use the new name.

[size=4][b]
My Config Instructions:[/b][/size]

If using Ultimate Villager Manager to change names:
Set the config for Ultimate Villager Manager as described above.
Then just leave my mod's config as the defaults. The default has DoChangeNames = false (because it is handled by UVM).

If [b]not[/b] using Ultimate Villager Manager, but want to change the name in some places, then set DoChangeNames = true, and LewisNewName = Krobus.
Note that it won't change any dialogue, just his name in the menu/portrait.

If you don't want to change the name (i.e. leave it as Lewis), then set DoChangeNames = false.

Downloads.Description:
This replaces the Mayor Lewis textures with Krobus.

Stopped him breathing.
Added some config. Optionally can change names in some places.
